Name: Sapphira
Summary: Sapphira conspired with her husband Ananias to keep back part of their land's price while claiming the whole. When Peter questioned her three hours after her husband's death, she repeated the lie and fell dead as well.
KeyStory: Sapphira agreed with her husband's lie and, questioned alone, told it again and fell at Peter's feet.
RelatedPeople: Ananias, Husband of Sapphira; Simon Peter
LifeLesson: A lie agreed together is still a lie each one tells. Sapphira had three hours to repent and used them to repeat.
